model: LingBot-VA 5B-DiT (11.5B package incl. text encoder+VAE) (robbyant/lingbot-va-posttrain-robotwin, repo@7c6ffa9)
hardware: Jetson Thor (SM110, aarch64), torch 2.11.0+cu130, server env mirrors H100 substrate (transformers 4.55.2, diffusers 0.36.0)

arm_notes.protocol: probe_latency.py real episode message order (reset -> infer -> compute_kv_cache -> ...), keyframes first-4-then-8, 8 cycles x 3 runs per arm, run 0 discarded (warm-up), cycle = 32 control steps. torch_ms/ours_ms = mean of the two kept runs' steady-state full-cycle p50.
arm_notes.torch: Stock upstream server (wan_va/wan_va_server.py, torchrun nproc=1, attn_mode='torch' custom sdpa per checkpoint config, flash_attn import-only shim never called). Kept-run p50: 18014.0 / 18040.8 ms (means 17983.1 / 18014.1, spread 0.2%). KV ramp +11% first->second half, as on H100. 1.8 Hz effective.
arm_notes.ours: InstinctFlash shipped chain via serve_variant.py: --no-fsdp --no-empty-cache --no-debug-dump --conditioning-prefill --ring-kv --conv-layout (fsdp_elision, allocator_churn_elision, debug_dump_elision, conditioning_prefill, conv-layout=ndhwc, ring-kv, generic-passes(default)) — identical to the H100 shipped configuration. Kept-run p50: 5598.7 / 5623.9 ms (means 5619.0 / 5623.3, spread 0.1%). 5.7 Hz effective. Accuracy tier: NUMERIC (conv-layout), certified non-inferior on H100 (555 paired episodes, p=0.00031); numerics not re-certified on Thor.
arm_notes.cross_check: H100 column: stock 8308 ms, shipped 2580.5 ms (3.22x). Thor reproduces the ratio (3.21x) at ~2.2x the absolute cycle time — the chain's win is not H100-specific.

walls: Checkpoint download: repo is ~24 GB (not ~9.5), Thor is on WiFi (~7 MB/s) shared with another agent's downloads; plain-http single-stream starved at 0.3 MB/s. Fixed by hf_transfer (parallel chunked); hf_xet on hub 0.34.4 was tried and REJECTED (discarded http partials, 0.05 MB/s). Total download wall ~3.5 h.
va_arm.sh v1 kill-by-pgid killed its own process group after the stock probes (data unaffected); replaced with anchored pgrep (^argv[0] + port) per the pkill footgun note.
Server load on Thor is fast (~40 s to listening) — the 11.5B-package load is not a wall.

declared_config_2v4a.note: changed-computation declared configuration — NOT comparable to the pytorch column; quality: untrained 2V/4A certified non-inferior on RoboTwin (90.8 vs 91.6 teacher, inside declared margin) on H100; device-numerics transfer to Thor not separately certified
declared_config_2v4a.protocol: identical to the other arms: shipped chain + --degrade-nfe 2,4 (serve_variant flags: degrade-nfe=2,4 + fsdp_elision, allocator_churn_elision, debug_dump_elision, conditioning_prefill, conv-layout=ndhwc, ring-kv, generic-passes(default)); probe_latency real message order, keyframes 4-then-8, 8 cycles x 3 runs, run 0 discarded; kept-run p50 888.0 / 897.8 ms (means 893.4 / 894.7, spread 0.1%)
